Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Our two most popular choices are the customizable Farmer Dan Meat Box and the curated Family Farm Box. Here is how they compare:
• Farmer Dan Meat Box (Starts at $169): Our #1 best seller. It offers maximum flexibility by letting you pick your favorite cuts, choose your delivery schedule, and skip or cancel anytime. Plus, subscribers get Free Ground Beef for Life in every delivery.
• Family Farm Box ($199): A pre-curated box designed for busy families. It includes a set selection of everyday staples like chicken breasts, sirloin steaks, ground beef, burger patties, bacon, breakfast sausage, and pork chops.
If you prefer choosing your own cuts and unlocking subscriber perks, the Farmer Dan Meat Box is your best option. If you prefer a ready-made mix of family staples without having to select individual items, the Family Farm Box is ideal.
